newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGE MULLS SUEZ BUY - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: CGE MULLS SUEZ BUY - PAPER.

text.p: French utilities company Cie Generale des Eaux (CGE) is considering making a hostile bid for holding company Cie de Suez , financial weekly Investir reported in its latest edition made available to Reuters on Friday.
But a source close to CGE said an aquisition of Suez was not part of the strategy of CGE chairman Jean-Marie Messier.
CGE would mount the bid on Suez to stop the holding company falling into the hands of its archrival, Lyonnaise des Eaux, the weekly reported.

"Since there is no doubt about a merger between Lyonnaise des Eaux and Suez, Generale des Eaux is preparing a counter-offensive. According to two sources close the deal, it could even take the form of a hostile bid," it said.

Asked about the report, the source close to CGE said, "This sort of project does not at all come within the strategy of Generale des Eaux which is dedicated to focusing on its activities in environmental services, construction and communication, and the sale of non-core assets."
